plan.notes: Official 'Degree Program Guide' (suggested 4-year curriculum) from the ODU 2025-2026 Undergraduate Catalog. All 8 semester grids transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (15/15/17/17/15/15/12/14); Total Credit Hours 120. The sample schedule assumes Language and Culture requirements were met by high school language courses; if not, language credits are taken as electives. A minor is recommended for upper-division general education but not required. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
